rationale: Colin's deep experience bridging GPU infrastructure with developer adoption (Nebius, Dabl.Club) and Mark's conviction that AI access isn't the bottleneck—knowing how to use it well is—create a natural pairing around developer-focused AI tooling and ecosystem strategy. Both operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI infrastructure, and Colin's track record mentoring on developer relations strategy complements Mark's growth and GTM expertise as he scales AI upskilling across Taiwan.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Mark Mi — you're both building at the intersection of Web3, AI, and developer adoption, and your experience bridging infrastructure with ecosystem growth could inform each other's approach.
